notes:
Uninstall every copy of Kairos.app on macOS, not just the installed one

Uninstall only deleted ~/Applications/Kairos.app, and only when running from
it, so the copy first opened from Downloads stayed behind and still showed up
in Spotlight. It now also removes copies in /Applications, the running one,
and any Spotlight finds under the home folder or /Applications, each checked
for Kairos' bundle identifier first.
